kind.description: bridge = thin adapter over an external pack; adapter = direct tool; suite = tool family; platform = runtime target.

source.description: Upstream URL of the wrapped tool or pack.

license.description: SPDX id of the wrapped tool. Copyleft (GPL/AGPL) requires linkage: subprocess.

linkage.description: How Axiom invokes the wrapped tool. Copyleft tools MUST be subprocess.

external.description: External pack contract: pip spec, entry point, CLI, supported input formats/versions.

dependencies.description: Install specs for the wrapped tool (pip requirement, apt package, image ref).

facets.description: Selection facets. Stamped by scripts/build_tool_index.py from registries/tool-facets.yaml.
